test_metrics.note: Resized-grid task-wise Dice; datasets mix official and project splits. HC18 test is held out from the labelled release training set, not the official challenge test set.

protocol.purpose: Diagnosis only; no training, threshold search, area filtering, or calibration.
protocol.analysis: Same fixed metrics on all available abdominal splits and CT groups.
protocol.test_reuse_warning: Test findings are exploratory evidence; new changes require train/validation selection and fresh confirmatory evaluation.
protocol.routing: Top-1 expert and mean probability of expert 8, by present/empty organ.
protocol.missing_channels: Outputs without annotation are counted separately and are not false positives.

findings.status: Diagnostic evidence completed; proposed auxiliary loss is not yet validated as an improvement.

hypothesis_results.hypothesis: Empty-image false-positive rate is driven by isolated single pixels.
hypothesis_results.evidence: Test liver 65/66 empty images contain predictions; none has <=16 predicted pixels. Median 4,246; mean 9,590; pixel FP rate 5.15% over valid empty-image pixels.
All 926 images are 449x464. Nearest-neighbor resize to512 preserves positive-image presence for all five structures; zero disappeared masks in train/test.

hypothesis_results.hypothesis: Ignore pixels are incorrectly scored as background.
hypothesis_results.evidence: Native ignore fraction30.1129%; resized30.0198%; diagnostics excludes ignore from TP/FP/FN/TN. This does not verify unknown semantic meaning of gray mask region.

hypothesis_results.hypothesis: Abdominal region proposals route to incorrect experts.
hypothesis_results.evidence: All five abdominal channels choose expert8 at all four levels for every train/test image, both empty and positive. Routing weights/other channels may still affect representation.

hypothesis_results.hypothesis: Liver false positives are only a held-out-domain generalization issue.
hypothesis_results.evidence: Train liver emptyFP134/177=75.71%, median area1044.5; test65/66=98.48%, median4246. Error exists in fitting and is larger on held-out CTs.

hypothesis_results.hypothesis: Rare-organ weakness includes missed detections and domain generalization.
hypothesis_results.evidence: Test zero-overlap kidney46/174, vessels78/151, spleen34/75; spleen trainDice0.8247 vs test0.3062. Vessels trainDice0.6229 vs test0.3720. Association supports underfitting/generalization hypotheses but does not identify a unique causal mechanism.

proposed_candidate.scope: Only abdomen channel indices with >=1 valid pixel and zero valid positive pixels; missing/ignored/positive pixels are never treated as negative.
proposed_candidate.rationale: Current empty-channel BCE averages over ~183449 valid pixels and can dilute local high-confidence false positives. Top1% concentrates a small auxiliary negative penalty; existing positive loss remains unchanged.
proposed_candidate.limitations: Could worsen recall through shared parameters; retain positive Dice and recall safeguards. It addresses FP specifically and does not establish a remedy for all abdominal weaknesses.
proposed_candidate.evaluation: Fresh training on source train CTs, select only on held-out training CT validation. Do not fine-tune the all9-CT checkpoint and report CT3/4 as unseen validation. Never select threshold, area filter, loss weight, or checkpoint on release test.

reproduction.note: Small differences from stored metrics are compatible with batch4 versus batch16 floating-point execution near threshold; every empty false-positive image count matches.

findings.raw_rgb_note: Indexed label domain, image/mask dimensions and resized presence verified directly. Archived conversion report states exact mapping and roundtrip checks; original RGB mask directory is absent locally.

unannotated_output_limitation.evidence: On abdominal test images, unannotated breast_lesion output predicts mean145631.8/262144 pixels; aponeurosis46573.4; thyroid_nodule28910.5 at0.5. Counts include the full output field because no target exists for these heads.
unannotated_output_limitation.interpretation: These predictions are unvalidated, not numerically established false positives. Missing labels are not negatives. Masked reported Dice/FP rates do not certify all-channel automatic inference reliability.
unannotated_output_limitation.candidate_scope: Empty-channel auxiliary loss deliberately leaves missing channels untouched and does not solve cross-domain head calibration.

selection.aggregation: Unweighted mean over structures with applicable denominators; abdomen uses exactly five structures.

decision.next_step: Retain disabled empty loss; this candidate fails the prespecified safeguards.
decision.interpretation: Single-seed validation pilot only; no proven improvement or test claim.

design.all_arms_start_from: each seed fair Region best.pt; AdamW optimizer reset
design.checkpoint_selection: max abdomen validation positive Dice among epochs 0..8 satisfying fixed baseline guards
design.random_seed_policy: same seed and epoch train draws across arms except declared abdomen sampling arm
design.test_policy: no test image or mask opened; no test metric used for model selection
design.mask_positive_definition: indexed original training mask has class 4 vessel or class 8 spleen

protocol.purpose: Validation-only exploratory postprocessing screen; no test images or masks opened
protocol.note: Both CT sources were inspected in superseded v1; this second screen is exploratory. The checkpoint was selected using validation data from both CTs. There is no independent validation source for model or postprocessing.
protocol.independent_units: 2 CT source groups; image counts are descriptive, not independent CT replicates
protocol.selection: Precision and recall rules selected under fixed safeguards on CT3 for four organs, CT4 for vessels; opposite CT is a limited check. Ignore labels are never used to form components.
protocol.confirmation_reporting: Only baseline and preselected candidate metrics appear in screen.json; per_image_counts.jsonl is an audit trace and must not be used to pick a replacement rule.
